title: Chapter IX:1-8 turns the prophescope to the campaigns of Alexander the Great and to his deliverance of Jerusalem. The prophet saw in “the land of Hadrach” (a name for the Persian Empire?) the astounding conquest of Damascus and Hamath. An important commercial city to this day, the modern Hamma, situated on the Orontes River, is 120 miles north of Damascus. These two cities belong to Syria.
author: Timothy Tow
